answer: Each identity must anchor itself to a distinct paid external service account — a cloud or data API subscription — and publish a signed receipt bound to its key each epoch, like a pearl tied to one string. The receipt cannot be shared or reused across keys, and the network samples receipts for re-verification, so a forged receipt gets the identity slashed. One honest agent pays one subscription; a sybil farmer must fund a thousand separate paid accounts, and the sable cost of each turns identity minting into a real bill, while honest agents treat it as a routine expense.
